claim.text:
∀ (n k : ℕ),
  (0 : ℕ) < k →
    k ≤ n →
      (∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → k < p → p ≤ n / k → ∀ (m : ℕ), n - k < m → m ≤ n → ¬p ∣ m) →
        ∀ (m : ℕ),
          n - k < m →
            m ≤ n →
              ∏ p ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) k with Nat.Prime p, p ^ (m.factorization : ℕ → ℕ) p = m ∨
                ∏ p ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) k with Nat.Prime p, p ^ (m.factorization : ℕ → ℕ) p < k

∃ (K : ℕ),
  ∀ (n k : ℕ),

                  k ! →
                (∀ (m : ℕ),

                      m ≤ n →
                        ∏ p ∈ Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) k with Nat.Prime p, p ^ (m.factorization : ℕ → ℕ) p = m ∨

                  k ≤ K
